tweets.text:
Interesting facts about the judge blocking President Trump’s election integrity order: 

1. In February, Kollar-Kotelly temporarily blocked DOGE from gaining access to the Treasury Department’s payment records.

2. She was the judge who ruled against Trump in his first term when he tried to form the Election Integrity Advisory Commission. 

3.  She sentenced a 75 year old Catholic woman Lauren Handy, to five years in prison for praying in front of an abortion clinic. 

4. In October 2017, the judge blocked Trump’s directive to prevent transgender military service. 

5. She is one of the judges who went off after Trump issued J6 pardons. 

So fair. So impartial. So unbiased. 

Said no one ever.
